questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from another lane may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs indicate a no passing zone. You cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign indicates a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal shown means a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to follow the signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show you are near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Reduce your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that road construction is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn carriages, and farm equipment display this emblem to warn other drivers that they travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means slow down and be ready to stop to let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass. Once it is safe, you may proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid accidents and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Prepare for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a road intersection is straight ahead. Slow down and get ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions because tires will have less grip on the pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that other vehicles will be entering your lane from the right. Be prepared for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the cyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on vehicles that travel at slower speeds than regular traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round yellow sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you must obey it. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you that the road splits into two directions. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that another road crosses ahead. Be ready for vehicles coming from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Only proceed when you are sure no trains are coming.
